description: NaAu(SO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.79 Å. Au is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.03 Å) and two longer (2.05 Å) Au-O bond lengths. S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.44-1.56 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Au and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Au, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one S atom.
